paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of wire-arc directed energy deposited 205C aluminum alloy

evidence.quote: This study focuses on the fabrication of thin-walled components using Al-Cu-Mn-Ni-Zr high-strength and heat-resistant aluminum alloy wires via the CMT process using 205C aluminum alloy wires.
